mapper.select: WITH step_group AS ( SELECT s.* , SUM(CASE WHEN s.apr04_step_type_cd != '20' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY s.apr04_appr_id ORDER BY s.apr04_seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS grp_no FROM apr04_appr_step s WHERE s.apr04_step_type_cd NOT IN ('30') ), active_step AS ( SELECT * FROM step_group s WHERE s.apr04_step_status_cd NOT IN ('20','30') ), my_step AS ( SELECT * FROM active_step s WHERE s.apr04_step_emp_id IN ( #{personId}, ( SELECT apr07_target_emp_id FROM apr07_alt_appr WHERE apr07_alt_emp_id = #{personId} AND f_trunc(f_sysdate()) BETWEEN apr07_start_date AND apr07_close_date LIMIT 1 ) ) ) SELECT a.apr01_appr_id AS appr_id , a.apr01_reg_date AS reg_date , a.apr01_title AS title , f_emp_kor_nm(a.apr01_reg_emp_id) AS reg_emp_name FROM apr01_appr a INNER JOIN my_step b ON a.apr01_appr_id = b.apr04_appr_id WHERE a.apr01_status_cd NOT IN ('30','40','99') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM active_step prev WHERE prev.apr04_appr_id = b.apr04_appr_id AND prev.apr04_seq < b.apr04_seq AND prev.grp_no < b.grp_no AND prev.apr04_step_type_cd != '20' ) ORDER BY a.apr01_reg_date DESC, a.apr01_appr_id DESC, a.apr01_title
